svg.aria-label: Ideal dynamic quenching changes intensity and lifetime together, while pure optical attenuation preserves lifetime. The right panel uses a cuvette-midpoint inner-filter approximation: more concentration increases emitters but attenuates excitation and emission, producing a maximum through competition. Both panels are specified explanatory models.
